title: HOLLOWMERE
lines: There is a village called Hollowmere, in a vale beneath a castle called Vane. For as long as anyone still living can remember, the dead here have not stayed dead.
Every night they rise — out of the churchyard, out of the fields, out of the black water of the mere — and every night the living must stand against them until dawn.
No one living knows why. A few have guessed. High in the castle, some nights, a bell tolls from a tower no one has climbed in years.
You are one of the watchers now. Take up whatever you can hold, and keep the vigil.
Hold the night. Dawn is the only victory there is.
